title: xivl-tools comparison oracle record
description: Describes how to invoke an external implementation the owner already has on disk. It contains no upstream code and never causes a download, checkout, or build of that project.

license.description: SPDX identifier, or 'none'. This records owner compliance and grants no reuse right.

rootOption.description: Runner option carrying the owner-supplied path to the external tool. There is no default value.

commandTemplate.description: Argument vector with the placeholders {root}, {input}, and {output}. No shell is involved.

outputAdapter.description: In-house script that converts the external tool's output into this project's normalized JSON form.
